name: xyz.trusteed/mcp-gateway
description: Agentic commerce gateway: discovery, trust and checkout. Demo store; x402 sandbox, AP2 planned.

tools.name: search_products_enriched
tools.description: Search products with enriched data including structured attributes, variants, GTIN, and images. Ideal for comparison and detailed product discovery. Matching is keyword/substring-based (title, description, tags, vendor) with rating-then-review ordering — the rating and review count it orders by are asserted by the merchant and are not verified by Trusteed. Use this when you have concrete keywords, a category, or a price range.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search products in Demo Store. Returns matching products with prices, images, availability, and direct links. Results include data for generating a visual product carousel artifact with category filtering. Use it for browsing and quick lists; when you need variants, attributes, GTIN or several images per product, use search_products_enriched instead (if the store offers it).

query.description: Search query (e.g. 'red sneakers', 'winter jacket'). Omit to list all products.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from next_cursor of a previous response. Only valid for the SAME query, category, price range and sort_by — a cursor replayed against different filters is rejected, not silently applied.

field_mask.description: Return only these product fields, to spend less of your context on a large catalogue. `id` is always included. Supplying a mask also drops the carousel/UI payloads, which are the bulk of a full response.

compact.description: When true, the same products are described only once instead of twice. `structuredContent.products` stays the full typed record — every field, every product, untouched — but the text reply becomes a short id/title/price/currency/availability line per product instead of a markdown re-narration of that same data (images, links, ratings inline). Nothing that asserts trust is affected: `merchant_trust`, `rating_provenance` and `sort_provenance_warning` are never trimmed by this flag. Ignored when `field_mask` is also set — a field mask already replaces the narration with a compact listing, so there is nothing left for `compact` to cut.

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific product in Demo Store, including all variants, sizes, colors, and availability.

product_id.description: Product ID — use the `id` field returned by search_products or nlweb_ask (e.g. 'prod-001'). Do not invent IDs.

tools.name: browse_categories
tools.description: List all product categories in Demo Store with product counts.

tools.name: get_merchant_profile
tools.description: Get the complete profile — trust score, policies, compliance, and protocol support — of the merchant this MCP endpoint belongs to. Takes NO parameters: the merchant is fixed by which store's /:storeSlug/mcp endpoint you connected to, not by an argument. To read a different merchant's profile, call this same tool on that merchant's own endpoint instead.

tools.name: get_site_map
tools.description: Returns the complete site map of Trusteed: all public pages organized by category. Use this to discover what sections are available (docs, blog, integrations, legal, marketing) and find the right path before calling get_page_content.

category.description: Filter pages by category: commerce, docs, legal, blog, marketing, integrations

tools.name: get_page_content
tools.description: Get a SUMMARY of a specific page on Trusteed: its title, description, keywords, related tools and the link to the full page. It returns a summary, not the full page text: read the linked URL when the whole page is needed. `content_scope` says what came back. Pass the page slug (e.g. 'for-agents', 'pricing', 'blog') or a blog post slug (returns its excerpt). Use get_site_map first to discover available slugs. Pass page='blog' to list all blog posts.

page.description: Page slug (e.g. 'for-agents', 'pricing', 'trust') or blog post slug. Use 'blog' to list all blog posts.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Full-text search across all Trusteed public documentation: pages, blog posts, FAQ entries, error codes, the agent checkout guide, and the tools of this endpoint. Returns ranked results by relevance. Use this to find answers about protocols, pricing, integration guides, trust scores, and more.

query.description: Search query, e.g. 'trust score threshold', 'shopify integration', 'rate limits'

type.description: Filter results by type: page, blog, faq, error (error codes), guide (checkout guide sections) or tool (tools served by this endpoint). Omit to search all types.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compare 2 to 5 products side-by-side with normalized attribute table and best-value recommendation.

product_ids.description: Array of product IDs to compare (2-5)

tools.name: get_payment_methods
tools.description: List the payment rails Demo Store really accepts (e.g. stripe, x402), with the instruments available per rail (card, apple_pay, usdc_base, ...). Derived from the merchant's live connection state — call this BEFORE checkout to negotiate a rail the agent can settle.

currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 currency of the cart (e.g. EUR). Only effective_methods is evaluated for it; accepted_rails never changes.

tool.description: Optional checkout tool the methods are evaluated for. Default complete_checkout.

tools.name: create_sandbox_key
tools.description: Get a temporary sandbox credential for this demo store, valid 24h. Present it as an `Authorization: Bearer` header, or — when your client cannot set headers — as the `agent_key` argument of the checkout tools. Payments here are simulated: this credential settles nothing and works only on the demo store. No human login is involved at any point.

tools.name: get_store_trust
tools.description: Get Demo Store's signed trust score (v4.1, 0-100) with per-signal data quality, confidence level, and a detached JWS for offline verification. Don't trust the number — verify it: download the JWKS at jwks_snapshot_uri, validate jws_compact with signing_kid, and recompute payload_hash_sha256.
